note: One of Yokum's Vacationland's two campgrounds at Seneca Rocks, across the road from the Rocks and bordering Seneca Creek; RV hookup sites along the creek and through the campground, tent and electric pop-up sites, teepees and bunkhouses. Unrated on RV Life; Google 4.7 over 10 reviews, and Yokum's Vacationland as a whole 4.6 over 569. --Claude
summary: Operator's page (©2026) confirms RV camping $50 for 1-4 people (fees now manual), no reservations for camping (booking manual: not reservable, FCFS), open in winter (season year_round manual), and a dump station. Not stated: hookup types/amps, site count or lengths, showers. The $50 base is at, not over, the US$50 line; working site with phones 800-772-8342 / 304-567-2351. Family has not stayed (no trip references). Note trimmed of the winter-season, FCFS and price restatements.
